files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Meal delivery as a week: one column per day (its name and delivery note) with the meal of that day as a small
  card (picture, name, weight, price). Axes: media (image, none), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";
  import type { DishSection } from "./restaurant-menu.types";

  export type WeekMenuProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    dishes: Dish[];
    sections: DishSection[];
    empty?: string;
    labels: FoodLabels;
    media?: "image" | "none";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { fmtMoney } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    dishes,
    sections,
    empty = "",
    labels,
    media = "image",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: WeekMenuProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((sections?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="calendar" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <Box class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5" data-slot="items">
      {#each sections as s (s.id)}
        <Stack gap="2" class="border-t-2 border-primary pt-4" data-slot="day">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {s.title}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {s.note}
          </Text>
          {#each dishes as d (d.id)}
            {#if (d.tag === s.key)}
              <Stack gap="2" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4" data-slot="item">
                {#if ((media as string) === "image")}
                  <MediaFrame alt={d.name} ratio="4/3" />
                {/if}
                <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                  {d.name}
                </Text>
                <Group gap="2" align="baseline" justify="between">
                  <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                    {d.weight}
                  </Text>
                  <Inline class="text-sm font-bold">
                    {fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency)}
                  </Inline>
                </Group>
              </Stack>
            {/if}
          {/each}
        </Stack>
      {/each}
    </Box>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
